verdicts.reason: A keeps the original text stack intact (eyebrow → headline → subcopy → CTA) with clear hierarchy, but it reads as a shrunk copy dropped in the centre: about 225px of empty band on the left and about 150px on the right, the circle is shown whole instead of bleeding off the edge, and the legal line floats far below the cluster. B breaks up the copy group. '20% off' sits alone in the middle column above the shoe, cut off from its 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow and its 'Every mixed case.' subcopy on the left, so the reading order jumps around. The legal text is shrunk until it can't be read, and the enlarged shoe crowds the headline.
